name: sit-show-hand
description: The wolf shows his hand while seated. SpeAction/sit show hand is derived from ProAction/Take a seat record 4 (the seated body) plus the right-arm gesture of SpeAction/say hello records 2-4 (rShoulder 100, rArm 15/5/15, rHand 70); only the right arm moves, every record re-sends the seated frame, and the head stays centred. Built by build/sit/build_show_hand.py. Watched on hardware 2026-11-10: only the right arm moved and it read as the wolf showing his paw, progress-100 at 3578 ms. SAFETY: record 4 is a transient frame, not a rest pose, so keep the sequence short and autoStand on. Copy build/sit/final/*.sh to D:\SpeAction first.
